entry: Market at the following hourly open once the selected first-breach wick candle closes, one attempt per NY week.
ladder: Accept the first eligible 1H, enclosing 4H, or enclosing 12H independently. Exit at the existing protective stop or intrabar 12H cloud flip, final close if still open.
recheck: Same ladder and protections. Flatten at the next open when the enclosing 12H closes without strict wick and aligned trend. Skip if already invalid at the entry boundary.
wait_12h: Independently select the earliest eligible strict 12H signal in each week. Use original protections.
costs: All entries and exits are taker. No additional slippage, funding, margin limits or compounding.
excursions: Gross favorable excursion before exit relative to actual entry-to-original-stop distance. Bounds only differ for unsequenced stop-hour highs/lows.
